name: hermes-bridge-relay
description: Standalone Hermes Bridge relay HTTP, WebSocket, and push worker

scripts.build:server: esbuild server/http.ts db/migrate.ts --platform=node --format=esm --out-extension:.js=.mjs --outdir=. && esbuild server/ws.ts --bundle --packages=external --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=server/ws.mjs && esbuild server/push.ts --bundle --packages=external --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=server/push.mjs
